eatingOutPriceLevel.basis: Price level of restaurants and hotels relative to Finland, World Bank International Comparison Program 2021.
eatingOutPriceLevel.limitations: The programme prices restaurants and hotels together, so hotel prices are part of this figure.

coldestMonthMean.basis: Average temperature of the coldest month, Berlin-Brandenburg, climate normals 1991-2020.

warmestMonthMeanMax.basis: Average daily high of the warmest month, Berlin-Brandenburg, climate normals 1991-2020.

decemberDaylight.basis: Sunrise to sunset on 21 December at latitude 52.52°, calculated.

foreignBornShare.basis: Foreign citizens as a share of Berlin's registered residents on 30 June 2026 (972,941 of 3,917,196).
foreignBornShare.limitations: Counts foreign citizens, not people born abroad; the share born abroad is higher, because many residents born abroad are German citizens.

carCommuteShare.basis: Share of journeys to work by car or motorcycle (Urban Audit, TT1012V).

cityWide.basis: €15.78 per m² × 50 m², the app's assumed size for 1 bedroom.
cityWide.limitations: Median asking rent per m² across all advertised flats in Berlin (IBB Wohnungsmarktbericht 2025, 40,014 listings); no split by size. Net cold rent: operating costs and heating are added under utilities.

rent.dwelling: flat of any size (net cold rent)
rent.adjustment: Converted from a rent per m² at 50 m².

cityWide.basis: €15.78 per m² × 70 m², the app's assumed size for 2 bedrooms.
cityWide.limitations: Median asking rent per m² across all advertised flats in Berlin (IBB Wohnungsmarktbericht 2025, 40,014 listings); no split by size. Net cold rent: operating costs and heating are added under utilities.

rent.dwelling: flat of any size (net cold rent)
rent.adjustment: Converted from a rent per m² at 70 m².

cityWide.limitations: Median asking rent per m² across all advertised flats in Berlin (IBB Wohnungsmarktbericht 2025, 40,014 listings); no split by size. Net cold rent: operating costs and heating are added under utilities.

rent.dwelling: flat of any size (net cold rent)
rent.adjustment: Converted from a rent per m² at 90 m².

cityWide.limitations: Median asking rent per m² across all advertised flats in Berlin (IBB Wohnungsmarktbericht 2025, 40,014 listings); no split by size. Net cold rent: operating costs and heating are added under utilities.

rent.dwelling: flat of any size (net cold rent)
rent.adjustment: Converted from a rent per m² at 110 m².

groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on food and drink at home, €362 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 0.96 times Finland's.
groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

eatingOut.basis: Average spending in Finland on eating out and hotels, €196 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 0.89 times Finland's.
eatingOut.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

recreation.basis: Average spending in Finland on leisure and holidays, €251 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 0.88 times Finland's.
recreation.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

clothing.basis: Average spending in Finland on clothes and shoes, €111 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 0.89 times Finland's.
clothing.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

communicationsPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on phone and internet (services and devices), €70 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 1.19 times Finland's.
communicationsPerAdultEquivalent.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

1.basis: Electricity: 2,000 kWh a year (app assumption for 1 bedroom) at €0.3869 per kWh, the national household price with taxes. Operating costs billed to tenants in Germany, Betriebskostenspiegel for 2024 (Deutscher Mieterbund): the sum of all cost types, €3.31 per m² a month, including heating, hot water and water; €2.89 without lift, garden care and cable. Applied to 50 m².
1.limitations: Electricity use is an app assumption and varies with appliances, cooking and cooling.

transitPassAdult.basis: Deutschlandticket, valid on all local transport in Germany; €66.80 from January 2027.

healthcarePerPerson.basis: Household out-of-pocket health spending per inhabitant in Germany (€702.63 a year).
healthcarePerPerson.limitations: A national average across all ages; spending is lower for most working-age adults and higher for older people.

childcarePerChild.basis: Kita places in Berlin are free; parents pay a €23 meal contribution. Providers may charge up to €100 more a month for extras.
childcarePerChild.limitations: Covers public and subsidised places; a place is not guaranteed at a particular Kita.
